pr.title: fix(utils/body,validator): normalize Content-Type media type for case-insensitive matching
pr.body:
Fixes #5060

(checklist: Add tests [x], Run tests [x], format/lint [x], Add TSDoc/JSDoc [ ])

intent.summary: Make Content-Type media-type matching case-insensitive in parseBody() and validator() so valid mixed-case values such as `Application/JSON`, `Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded`, or `Multipart/Form-Data; boundary=...` are parsed/validated instead of silently skipped (returning `{}` / unvalidated data), while keeping case-sensitive parameters such as the multipart boundary intact. To make mixed-case multipart parse consistently, parseBody's form path now reads the body as an ArrayBuffer and parses it via bufferToFormData (which lowercases only the media-type portion), caching the resulting FormData promise on HonoRequest.bodyCache. Must not regress existing parseBody / validator / c.req body-caching behavior.
